# Juno Upgrade (v28)

 This upgrade implements Cosmos SDK 50 & Cosmwasm 2 with Juno v28.0.2.
## Voting Options
YES: Agree to proceed with the v28.0.2 network upgrade.
NO: Disagree with the v28.0.2 network upgrade.
